title: InspectorProtocolFrame
description: SSOT 文档。两端常量模块 (inspectorConstants.js / inspector_constants.py) 镜像此 schema,集成测试兜底。帧 = 单行 NDJSON。

oneOf.title: Request
oneOf.description: JS → Python。有 id 等响应。

oneOf.title: Response
oneOf.description: Python → JS。id 匹配 Request。success=false 时带 error。异构字段按命令返回: start-session→session_id/warning, get-screenshot→screenshot, get-source→source/elements, find-locators→locators, refresh→screenshot/source/elements。字段契约以 Python inspector_service.py 各方法 return dict 为准。

error.description: success=false 时附带, i18n key 或原始错误信息

session_id.description: start-session 成功返回, Appium driver.session_id

source.description: get-source/refresh 返回, XML page source 字符串

elements.description: get-source/refresh 返回, 解析后的根节点树对象 (含 tagName/attributes/children/path)

locators.description: find-locators 返回, locator dict 数组 (type/value/description)

warning.description: start-session 端口冲突等非致命附带信息

oneOf.title: Notification
oneOf.description: Python → JS。无 id,fire-and-forget。type=ready 握手,type=progress 进度。R10: additionalProperties 收紧为 false, 新增 payload 字段需先在此登记。

stage.description: progress 通知的当前阶段标识 (如 appium-starting/screenshot-capturing)

payload.description: R10: 扩展 payload 容器, 未来新增字段统一放此 (避免每次扩 schema)
